Name: Flowers Bubble Tea
Author: Damadelfalco
Description:
[b][img]https://i.postimg.cc/NFwp5gM9/testata.png[/img]

I'm totally obsessed with bubble tea, and guess what? I've been thinking about making some in my Stardew farm too!

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/MTB96cWJ/bubbletea-cup.png[/img]﻿

[/b]So, you'll find 12 brand-new flower types, and you can use each one to whip up its own special bubble tea.
Each drink gives you some cool buffs that'll help you out on the farm and even when you're down in the mines!

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/sX32NTRq/tit-flowers.png[/img]﻿
Eleven of the flower types you can grow in spring, summer, and fall, but there's one special one that only pops up in winter.
The seeds take about 7 days to sprout into flowers.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/15X8S7NZ/scheda.png[/img]

You can find the seeds in various shops or during events. You can either trade for 'em or just buy 'em straight up.
Here's where to find them:

[spoiler]
[b][color=#00ffff]Pierre's Shop (Season spring, summer, fall) :[/color][/b]

- EternalRose FlowerTea Seeds
- Pinky FlowerTea Seeds
- Sunny FlowerTea Seeds
- Ninfea FlowerTea Seeds

[b][color=#00ffff]Krobus (Season spring, summer, fall) :[/color][/b]

- BlackNinfea FlowerTea Seeds (trade with 5 Bat wing)

[b][color=#00ffff]Island Trader (Season spring, summer, fall) :[/color][/b]

- Paradise FlowerTea Seeds (trade with 3 Coral)
- Rainbow FlowerTea Seeds (trade with 2 Rainbow shell)

[color=#00ffff][b]Sandy's Shop Desert Oasis (Season spring, summer, fall) :[/b][/color]

- LovelyDaisy FlowerTea Seeds
- Tiny FlowerTea Seeds
- Violet FlowerTea Seeds

[color=#00ffff][b]Eggs Festival - Pierre[/b][/color]

- Fluffy FlowerTea Seeds

[b][color=#00ffff]Festival on Ice - Traveling Merchant[/color][/b]

- WinterStar FlowerTea Seeds
[/spoiler]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/MpjXMcDP/tit-bubble.png[/img]

You'll get the bubble tea recipes in the mail from some of the Pelican Town folks once you become good enough buddies with them
(you gotta get to a certain heart level).

So, to make the bubble tea, you'll need the fruit-flavored balls, 2 flowers, and 1 cup of green tea.

If you've got the "Love of Cooking" mod, they'll just show up in the menu. If not, no worries, just click on your kitchen!


[img]https://i.postimg.cc/bY3ZKfrT/scheda-bubble.png[/img]

Here's who sends what and how many hearts you need:

[spoiler]
- BlackNinfea FlowerTea Bubble Tea - Wizard 2 hearts
- EternalRose FlowerTea Bubble Tea - Elliott 3 hearts
- Fluffy FlowerTea Bubble Tea - Caroline 2 hearts
- LovelyDaisy FlowerTea Bubble Tea - Linus 2 hearts
- Ninfea FlowerTea Bubble Tea - Demetrius 2 hearts
- Paradise FlowerTea Bubble Tea - Sandy 2 hearts
- Pink FlowerTea Bubble Tea - Jas 2 hearts
- Rainbow FlowerTea Bubble Tea - Junimo via Wizard after the Community Center is complete
- Sunny FlowerTea Bubble Tea - Clint 2 hearts
- Tiny FlowerTea Bubble Tea - Willy 2 hearts
- Violet FlowerTea Bubble Tea - Leo 3 hearts
- WinterStar FlowerTea Bubble Tea - Dwarf when you reach level 6 in the mine
[/spoiler]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/Jn37Lv8M/tit-bubblemachine.png[/img]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/d3tLL4Hr/bubblemachine.gif[/img]

Now, for the bubble machine! Maru will email you the blueprint once you've become good friends with her.
This machine lets you make the little bubble balls, and you can make 'em in tons of flavors that match the different bubble teas. You'll mostly use fruits (except for one that needs void essence, whoa!), which are pretty easy to find.
To make the bubble balls, you'll also need some of those flavored balls made with easy-to-find fruits.
It takes 2 pieces of slime (you know, the stuff you get from slimes) and 3 fruits. Just drag the fruits onto the machine, and boom! After a bit, you'll have your bubble balls ready.

Here's how many hearts you need with Maru to get the blueprint:
[spoiler] 4 hearts (If you get the fourth heart during a game day, the blueprint will arrive the following day.) [/spoiler]

Here are the combinations to obtain the bubble tea spheres:
[spoiler]
- BlackNinfea FlowerTea pearls - 3 Void Essence + 2 slime
- EternalRose FlowerTea pearls - 3 Pomegranate + 2 slime
- Fluffy FlowerTea pearls - 3 Blackberry + 2 slime
- LovelyDaisy FlowerTea pearls - 3 Banana + 2 slime
- Ninfea FlowerTea pearls - 3 Strawberry + 2 slime
- Paradise FlowerTea pearls - 3 Mango + 2 slime
- Pinky FlowerTea pearls - 3 Peach + 2 slime
- Rainbow FlowerTea pearls - 3 Blueberry + 2 slime
- Sunny FlowerTea pearls - 3 Orange + 2 slime
- Tiny FlowerTea pearls - 3 Cherry + 2 slime
- Violet FlowerTea pearls - 3 Spice berry + 2 slime
- WinterStar FlowerTea pearls - 3 Cristal fruit + 2 slime
[/spoiler]

[b]Heads up! For now, the bubble ball flavors are set. If I get good enough at  scripting, maybe I'll figure out a way to let you customize the flavors later on.
I'm just not quite there yet with my coding skills!
[/b]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/NMb0qRsM/tit-install.png[/img]﻿

Download and install: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
Add the [b]Flowers Bubble Tea[/b] to your [b]Mods[/b] folder along with all dependencies
It's done!

To remove this mod, simply delete it from the mods folder.
Any items still present in the save file will be considered as incorrect objects (symbol with red circle and diagonal bar above) and can be thrown away.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/T1w3Rh1c/tit-translation.png[/img]﻿

Want to translate the mod? DM me or leave a comment if you're interested.

The Italian language is already translated.
If you want to translate to your language find the default.json file in the i18n folder and rename it.

Currently, I have two types of Chinese translations, and for the sake of accuracy, I will include both.
Sparkling123 - [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33566]Chinese[/url]
buliz - [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33561]Chinese mandarin[/url]
den2nova - [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33562]Japanese[/url]
Hayato2236 - [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33551]Latin Spanish[/url]
Tevahadoro - [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33568]Vietnamese[/url]
Vin163 - [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33585]French[/url]

[b][color=#00ff00]Thanks to all for the translations! [/color][/b]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/PqsJmtVt/tit-credits.png[/img]

I'll be keeping this mod updated, but if I'm unavailable for long, long time, or the project is discontinued, feel free to create
unofficial updates and post them in the comments.

You may not upload updated versions of [b]Flowers Bubble Tea[/b] to Nexus without first contacting me for permission.[b]

[u][color=#ff00ff]ART CREDITS[/color][/u][/b]

Just wanted to give a shout-out that the flowers I used are from the amazing [b]Tiny Garden set[/b] by Kathychow! You can find her awesome work here:
[url=https://kathychow.itch.io/16x16-tiny-garden-free-pack]https://kathychow.itch.io/16x16-tiny-garden-free-pack[/url]﻿

Seriously, her stuff is what got me inspired to make this mod in the first place. I
tried making a few flowers myself, but yeah, her work is definitely way
better!
The bubble machine and the bubble teas themselves? Those are all me!

[b][size=3]SPECIAL THANKS[/size][/b]

I'd like to thank Pathoschild for creating SMAPI and its related tools.
And of course, a big thank you to all the mod creators who make it possible to personalize our Stardew Valley games.
Finally, I want to express my gratitude to ConcernedApe for creating this wonderful world for us to enjoy.

If you want to buy me a cup of tea! [url=https://ko-fi.com/damadelfalco]Ko-Fi[/url] or [url=https://buymeacoffee.com/damadelfalco]Buymeacoffee[/url] :)

If you like this mod, you should totally check out my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31445]tomato mod[/url] too! It's got a ton of different kinds of tomatoes and new recipes.
